हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/FqmcEB
show.description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Yukanika , a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant , a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Yukanika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!
